key_insight: PANDA-D estimates both advancing and receding dynamic contact angles directly from density and layer-displacement profiles, avoiding explicit interface extraction.
engineering_relevance: This enables more reproducible and automated wetting analysis in molecular simulations, especially for driven liquid rolls on solid surfaces.
method: Fit a circular-meniscus model to the density profile and layerwise center-of-mass displacement.
Use the coupled profiles to resolve which meniscus is advancing vs. receding.
Recover both contact angles plus an effective near-wall offset without contour thresholding.
evidence_signal: On synthetic rolls the method achieved 0.29° RMS error, and on Lennard-Jones roll simulations it agreed with independent circle-fit angles to 0.84° RMS.
watch_item: The approach assumes the circular-meniscus model is adequate, so departures from that geometry may reduce accuracy.
paper_title: PANDA-D: Interface-free determination of two dynamic contact angles
